checks.detail: ConsumeOnceError(RuntimeError) is the base; ConsumeOnceReplayError and ConsumeOnceValidationError derive from it; HoldoutAlreadyConsumedError now inherits ConsumeOnceReplayError while remaining catchable as HoldoutAlreadyConsumedError for existing callers.
test_consume_persists_before_returning verifies the store records the consumption before AuthorityBroker returns the handle; the handle type identity is verified as HoldoutHandle is HoldoutConsumed.
The focused module contains 43 tests (14 T2 contract + 20 existing T3 + 9 new AuthorityBrokerHandleAndErrorTests); fresh run on the locked runtime reports 43 tests, 0 failures, OK.

Only research_automation/control_plane/final_evaluator.py and tests/test_control_plane_final_evaluator.py are changed; the four protected user files (CHANGELOG.md, daily_run.py, daily_select.py, docs/b1_v3_results.md) are untouched noise; no forbidden root is modified.

HoldoutConsumed.canonical_hash is deterministic and round-trip stable; receipt files are valid JSON without BOM; task_spec_sha256, task_payload_sha256 and evidence references cross-verify against the committed blobs.
No TODO, FIXME, XXX, NotImplemented, placeholder ellipsis or bare pass in the T3 additions to final_evaluator.py or its tests.
No real Final Holdout bytes are opened, read, or imported; HoldoutConsumed stores identity references only; all T3 fixtures are in-memory fakes; receipts record final_holdout_authorized=false.

advisories.detail: SideEffect.OPEN_HOLDOUT is declared in contracts but not yet enforced at broker level; the T4 TrustedEvaluator adapter must bind the lease allowed_side_effects before any real holdout capability can be granted.
Expired-authorization and consume-time identity-mismatch tests are specific to the _AuthorityStore flow and are covered by T4; they are explicitly out of scope for the in-memory store contract in T3.
